source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus file bytes, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

change.implementation: The renderer uses one OPEN_OBSIDIAN_THEME.metrics.iconSize token for the shared chrome glyphs, now 24px; CSS fallbacks and the static layout contract use the same value while compact hit areas remain unchanged.

limitations: This verifies the shared sizing contract, static layout and cross-platform builds; visual pixel comparison against the reference Obsidian window remains a separate human/reference-vault validation handoff.
